en.headline: Ukrainian drones strike Russian industrial and military sites
en.body: Ukrainian forces struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in the Astrakhan region and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on Nov. 15, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and Russian officials. The strikes caused a fire at a petrochemical plant and triggered ammunition detonations at the airfield.

fr.headline: Des drones ukrainiens frappent des sites industriels et militaires russes
fr.body: Les forces ukrainiennes ont frappé l'aérodrome militaire d'Akhtoubinsk, dans la région d'Astrakhan, ainsi que des entreprises pétrochimiques à Nijnekamsk dans la nuit du 15 novembre, selon l'état-major des forces armées ukrainiennes et des responsables russes. Les frappes ont provoqué un incendie dans une usine pétrochimique et déclenché des détonations de munitions sur l'aérodrome.

de.headline: Ukrainische Drohnen greifen russische Industrie- und Militäranlagen an
de.body: Ukrainische Streitkräfte haben in der Nacht zum 15. November den Militärflugplatz Achtubinsk in der Region Astrachan sowie petrochemische Betriebe in Nischnekamsk angegriffen, wie der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte und russische Beamte mitteilten. Die Angriffe verursachten einen Brand in einem petrochemischen Werk und lösten Munitionsexplosionen auf dem Flugplatz aus.

it.headline: Droni ucraini colpiscono siti industriali e militari russi
it.body: Nella notte del 15 novembre, le forze ucraine hanno colpito l'aeroporto militare di Akhtubinsk, nella regione di Astrakhan, e impianti petrolchimici a Nizhnekamsk, secondo quanto riferito dallo Stato Maggiore delle Forze Armate ucraine e da funzionari russi. Gli attacchi hanno provocato un incendio in un impianto petrolchimico e innescato detonazioni di munizioni presso l'aeroporto.

es.headline: Drones ucranianos atacan instalaciones industriales y militares rusas
es.body: Las fuerzas ucranianas atacaron el aeródromo militar de Akhtubinsk, en la región de Astracán, y empresas petroquímicas en Nizhnekamsk durante la noche del 15 de noviembre, según el Estado Mayor de las Fuerzas Armadas de Ucrania y funcionarios rusos. Los ataques provocaron un incendio en una planta petroquímica y detonaciones de municiones en el aeródromo.

zh.headline: 乌克兰无人机袭击俄罗斯工业和军事设施
zh.body: 据乌克兰武装部队总参谋部和俄罗斯官员称，11月15日夜间，乌克兰军队袭击了阿斯特拉罕地区的阿赫图宾斯克军用机场以及下卡姆斯克的石化企业。袭击导致一家石化工厂起火，并引发了机场内的弹药爆炸。

pt.headline: Drones ucranianos atingem instalações industriais e militares russas
pt.body: As forças ucranianas atacaram o aeródromo militar de Akhtubinsk, na região de Astrakhan, e empresas petroquímicas em Nizhnekamsk durante a noite de 15 de novembro, segundo o Estado-Maior das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia e responsáveis russos. Os ataques provocaram um incêndio numa fábrica petroquímica e desencadearam detonações de munições no aeródromo.

ja.headline: ウクライナ軍のドローン、ロシアの軍事・産業施設を攻撃
ja.body: ウクライナ軍参謀本部およびロシア当局によると、11月15日未明、ウクライナ軍がロシアのアストラハン州にあるアフトゥビンスク軍用飛行場と、ニジネカムスクの石油化学企業を攻撃した。この攻撃により、石油化学工場で火災が発生し、飛行場では弾薬の誘爆が確認された。

ko.headline: 우크라이나 드론, 러시아 산업 및 군사 시설 타격
ko.body: 우크라이나군이 11월 15일 밤사이 아스트라한 지역의 아흐투빈스크 군 비행장과 니즈네캄스크의 석유화학 기업들을 타격했다고 우크라이나군 참모부와 러시아 당국이 밝혔다. 이번 공격으로 석유화학 공장에서 화재가 발생했으며, 비행장에서는 탄약이 폭발했다.

en.headline: Zelenskyy reports US proposal for territorial concessions
en.body: U.S. negotiators suggested that Ukraine surrender territory in the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Zelenskyy stated that Russia also rejected a proposed energy truce.

fr.headline: Zelensky fait état d'une proposition américaine de concessions territoriales
fr.body: Des négociateurs américains ont suggéré que l'Ukraine cède des territoires dans la région du Donbass en échange d'une adhésion à l'OTAN, selon le président Volodymyr Zelensky. M. Zelensky a précisé que la Russie avait également rejeté une proposition de trêve énergétique.

de.headline: Selenskyj berichtet von US-Vorschlag zu Gebietsabtretungen
de.body: US-Unterhändler haben laut Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj vorgeschlagen, dass die Ukraine Gebiete im Donbass im Austausch für eine NATO-Mitgliedschaft abtritt. Selenskyj erklärte zudem, dass Russland einen Vorschlag für einen Energiewaffenstillstand abgelehnt habe.

it.headline: Zelensky riferisce di una proposta statunitense per concessioni territoriali
it.body: I negoziatori statunitensi hanno suggerito all'Ucraina di cedere territori nella regione del Donbass in cambio dell'adesione alla NATO, secondo quanto dichiarato dal presidente Volodymyr Zelensky. Zelensky ha inoltre affermato che la Russia ha respinto una proposta di tregua energetica.

es.headline: Zelenski informa sobre una propuesta de EE. UU. de concesiones territoriales
es.body: Negociadores estadounidenses sugirieron que Ucrania cediera territorio en la región del Donbás a cambio de su adhesión a la OTAN, según el presidente Volodímir Zelenski. Zelenski declaró que Rusia también rechazó una propuesta de tregua energética.

zh.headline: 泽连斯基称美国提议以领土换取北约成员国资格
zh.body: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，美国谈判代表建议乌克兰放弃顿巴斯地区的领土，以换取北约成员国资格。泽连斯基还称，俄罗斯拒绝了一项关于能源停火的提议。

pt.headline: Zelenskyy relata proposta dos EUA para concessões territoriais
pt.body: Negociadores dos EUA sugeriram que a Ucrânia cedesse território na região do Donbas em troca da adesão à NATO, segundo o Presidente Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Zelenskyy afirmou que a Rússia também rejeitou uma proposta de trégua energética.

ja.headline: ゼレンスキー大統領、米側から領土譲歩の提案があったと明かす
ja.body: ウクライナのウォロディミル・ゼレンスキー大統領によると、米国の交渉担当者が、NATO加盟と引き換えにドンバス地域の領土を割譲するようウクライナ側に提案した。また、ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシア側がエネルギー施設への攻撃停止案を拒否したことも明らかにした。

ko.headline: 젤렌스키, 미국의 영토 양보 제안 언급
ko.body: 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 대통령에 따르면, 미국 협상단은 우크라이나가 나토(NATO) 가입을 조건으로 돈바스 지역의 영토를 양보할 것을 제안했다. 젤렌스키 대통령은 러시아 또한 에너지 휴전 제안을 거부했다고 밝혔다.

en.headline: Zelenskyy calls for end to Starshield restrictions
en.body: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that restrictions on Starshield terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter. Zelenskyy reported that Russian forces launched over 2,300 strike drones and 15 missiles against Ukraine over the past week.

fr.headline: Zelensky appelle à la levée des restrictions sur Starshield
fr.body: Le président Volodymyr Zelensky a déclaré que les restrictions imposées aux terminaux Starshield entravent la défense énergétique de l'Ukraine à l'approche de l'hiver. M. Zelensky a rapporté que les forces russes avaient lancé plus de 2 300 drones d'attaque et 15 missiles contre l'Ukraine au cours de la semaine écoulée.

de.headline: Selenskyj fordert Ende der Starshield-Beschränkungen
de.body: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte, dass Beschränkungen für Starshield-Terminals die Energieverteidigung der Ukraine vor dem Winter behindern. Selenskyj berichtete, dass russische Streitkräfte in der vergangenen Woche über 2.300 Angriffsdrohnen und 15 Raketen gegen die Ukraine eingesetzt haben.

it.headline: Zelensky chiede la fine delle restrizioni su Starshield
it.body: Il presidente Volodymyr Zelensky ha dichiarato che le restrizioni sui terminali Starshield stanno ostacolando le difese energetiche dell'Ucraina in vista dell'inverno. Zelensky ha riferito che, nell'ultima settimana, le forze russe hanno lanciato oltre 2.300 droni d'attacco e 15 missili contro l'Ucraina.

es.headline: Zelenski pide el fin de las restricciones a Starshield
es.body: El presidente Volodímir Zelenski afirmó que las restricciones a los terminales Starshield están obstaculizando las defensas energéticas de Ucrania ante la llegada del invierno. Zelenski informó que las fuerzas rusas lanzaron más de 2.300 drones de ataque y 15 misiles contra Ucrania durante la última semana.

zh.headline: 泽连斯基呼吁解除对“星盾”系统的限制
zh.body: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，对“星盾”（Starshield）终端的限制阻碍了乌克兰在冬季来临前的能源防御工作。泽连斯基报告称，过去一周，俄罗斯军队向乌克兰发射了超过2300架攻击型无人机和15枚导弹。

pt.headline: Zelenskyy apela ao fim das restrições ao Starshield
pt.body: O Presidente Volodymyr Zelenskyy afirmou que as restrições aos terminais Starshield estão a prejudicar as defesas energéticas da Ucrânia antes do inverno. Zelenskyy relatou que as forças russas lançaram mais de 2.300 drones de ataque e 15 mísseis contra a Ucrânia durante a última semana.

ja.headline: ゼレンスキー大統領、スターシールドの制限解除を求める
ja.body: ゼレンスキー大統領は、衛星通信サービス「スターシールド」の端末に対する制限が、冬を控えたウクライナのエネルギー防衛を妨げていると述べた。同大統領によると、ロシア軍は過去1週間で2300機以上の攻撃ドローンと15発のミサイルをウクライナに向けて発射した。

ko.headline: 젤렌스키, 스타실드 제한 조치 해제 촉구
ko.body: 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 대통령은 스타실드 단말기에 대한 제한 조치가 겨울을 앞둔 우크라이나의 에너지 방어 체계를 저해하고 있다고 밝혔다. 젤렌스키 대통령은 지난주 러시아군이 우크라이나를 향해 2,300대 이상의 공격용 드론과 15발의 미사일을 발사했다고 보고했다.

en.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russian sites; Zelenskyy urges end to Starshield limits
en.dek: Ukraine struck Russian airfields and petrochemical plants overnight, while Zelenskyy pressed the U.S. to lift Starshield restrictions ahead of winter.
facts: Ukrainian drones struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in Astrakhan region and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on Nov. 15, causing fires and ammunition detonations, according to the Ukrainian General Staff and Russian officials.
Russian forces launched over 2,300 strike drones and 15 missiles against Ukraine over the past week, Zelenskyy reported.
U.S. negotiators suggested Ukraine surrender Donbas territory in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Zelenskyy stated that Russia also rejected a proposed energy truce.
Zelenskyy said restrictions on Starshield terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter.
At least 30 explosions were heard at the Akhtubinsk airfield following the Ukrainian strike.
body: Ukrainian forces struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in the Astrakhan region and petrochemical enterprises in Nizhnekamsk overnight on Nov. 15, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and Russian officials. The strikes caused a fire at a petrochemical plant and triggered ammunition detonations at the airfield.

Russian forces launched over 2,300 strike drones and 15 missiles against Ukraine over the past week, Zelenskyy reported, as he called for an end to Starshield restrictions that he said are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter.

U.S. negotiators suggested that Ukraine surrender territory in the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Zelenskyy stated that Russia also rejected a proposed energy truce.

Zelenskyy said restrictions on Starshield terminals are hindering Ukraine's energy defenses ahead of winter, warning that the limitations threaten Ukraine's ability to protect its energy infrastructure as cold weather approaches.
en.context: The Nov. 15 strikes mark the latest in a series of Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian military and industrial sites, while diplomatic efforts continue over territorial concessions and air defense capabilities ahead of winter.
